title: The Golden Compass
author: Philip Pullman
current_text: In 2007, The Golden Compass was pulled from St. John Neumann Middle and Lourdes High School in Oshkosh, WI, over concerns about what critics called its “anti-Christian message.” In 2008, The Golden Compass was removed from library shelves at dozens of schools in the publicly funded Halton (Ontario, Canada) Catholic School District after a challenge alleging that it was “written by an atheist where the characters and text are anti-God, anti-Catholic, and anti-religion”; it was later returned. The Calgary (Alberta, Canada) Catholic School District ordered The Golden Compass removed from its library shelves after detractors accused it of anti-religious content, then returned it two months later.
